paragraphs.text: Anyone who lives, works or studies in Greenfield can join the library free of charge. To register, come to the front desk with a document showing your name and address, such as a recent bill.

Adult members may borrow up to twelve books at a time for three weeks. DVDs can be borrowed for one week and cost £1.50 each. Items can be renewed twice, online or by phone, unless another member has reserved them.
If you lose your library card, a replacement costs £2. Please tell us as soon as possible so that nobody else can use your card.
The library runs a free homework club for children aged 8 to 14 on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. No booking is needed.

Computers with internet access can be used for up to one hour a day. Printing costs 10p per page in black and white and 50p per page in colour. Please ask a member of staff if you need help with the self-service machines.

items.quote: Anyone who lives, works or studies in Greenfield can join the library
items.prompt: Only people who live in Greenfield can join the library.

explanation.en: “Anyone who lives, works or studies in Greenfield” — people who work or study there can join too. “Only people who live” contradicts this → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «Anyone who lives, works or studies in Greenfield» — сол жерде жұмыс істейтіндер мен оқитындар да мүше бола алады. «Only people who live» мәтінге қайшы → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «Anyone who lives, works or studies in Greenfield» — вступить могут и те, кто там работает или учится. «Only people who live» противоречит тексту → FALSE.

items.quote: Adult members may borrow up to twelve books at a time for three weeks
items.prompt: Adult members can keep books for three weeks.

explanation.en: “Adult members may borrow up to twelve books at a time for three weeks”. “Keep books for three weeks” paraphrases this rule → TRUE. “Twelve” is the number of books, not the period.
explanation.kk: «Adult members may borrow up to twelve books at a time for three weeks» — ересектер кітапты үш аптаға алады. «Keep books for three weeks» — осы шарттың басқаша айтылымы → TRUE. «Twelve» — кітап саны, мерзімге қатысы жоқ.
explanation.ru: «Adult members may borrow up to twelve books at a time for three weeks» — взрослые берут книги на три недели. «Keep books for three weeks» — пересказ этого условия → TRUE. «Twelve» — количество книг, к сроку не относится.

items.quote: DVDs can be borrowed for one week and cost £1.50 each
items.prompt: Children can borrow DVDs free of charge.

explanation.en: The DVD price is given without saying who it applies to. There are no special conditions for children, so the statement can be neither confirmed nor contradicted → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: DVD бағасы кімге арналғаны нақтыланбай берілген. Балаларға бөлек шарт мәтінде жоқ, сондықтан растауға да, жоққа шығаруға да болмайды → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Цена DVD указана без уточнения, для кого она. Отдельных условий для детей в тексте нет, поэтому ни подтвердить, ни опровергнуть нельзя → NOT GIVEN.

items.quote: If you lose your library card, a replacement costs £2
items.prompt: Members have to pay to replace a lost card.

explanation.en: “a replacement costs £2” — a new card has to be paid for → TRUE.
explanation.kk: «a replacement costs £2» — жаңа карта үшін ақы төлеу керек → TRUE.
explanation.ru: «a replacement costs £2» — за новую карту нужно заплатить → TRUE.

items.prompt: Children must book a place at the homework club.

explanation.en: “No booking is needed” — but the statement says “must book” → FALSE.
explanation.kk: «No booking is needed» — алдын ала брондаудың қажеті жоқ, ал тұжырымда «must book» делінген → FALSE.
explanation.ru: «No booking is needed» — записываться не нужно, а в утверждении «must book» → FALSE.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the text. Do the following statements agree with the information given in the text? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.
